item.coloph: de ltar rgyun spyod gsol 'debs tshig 'phreng 'di/ tshe dbang bdag gis thugs kyi bcud phyung ste/ phyi rabs don du pha nor bu la bzhag skal ldan don gnyer can gyi nyams len gyis/ kha dad log lta can la gsang rgya sdoms/ g.yung drung gsal ba la sogs gshen la gtad/ dus kyi gru khug bon chos dar nub skabs/ dmu tsha mchog dang b+he ros brda yig bkod/ zhang zhung sgo mo shel le rgya gar (skar) gyi/ byang nub rin chen 'bar ba'i brag la sbos/ gter srung lnga la gnyer gtad bya ra gzobs/ phyis su rten 'brel rnam pa lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul sku gcig gis rnyed par shog/ phyis su bdag 'dra sems dpa' thugs rje nyi ma dang bla grwa mang tshan gyis/ phug leb 'o ma stag rtse ru/ gsang mchog rgyal po'i tshogs 'khor phul skabs/ smin snang la/ rig 'dzin bgres tshul gcig gis 'di skad gsungs/ 'o las 'phro ldan pa'i bla ma gson/ 'chi med rig 'dzin bsgrabs (sgrab) thabs zangs brag ri la sbas nas yod/ da lta'i rten 'brel phun 'tshogs dus/ zab mo gter gyi skal pa dbang*/ btang bzhag tshod la mkhas par gyis/ zhes gsungs snang cha de yar (yal) song / re dog (dogs) gang yang ma byas par sded (bsdad) de/ slar yang tshogs brgya thon skabs/ phran bla grwa 'ga' dang grogs gnyis bcas gnas mchog la skor ba phebs skabs/ 'o ma'i chu mig la rten khrus bya skabs/ mi mngon dbyings nas 'od gzugs gcig gis/ 'chi med rig 'dzin chen po yi/ bsgrubs (sgrub) thabs la cha'i sgrom bu zhig brag dmar tsi ta 'dra ba yi/ g.yon phyogs dkar dmar mtshams la yod/ da lta las 'phro khyod la dbang / lo gsum bka' rgya dam du gzob (gzobs)/ de mtshams 'gro la spel bar gyis/ zhes gsungs/ brag dmar snying 'dra ba gar yod grogs rnams la dris pas/ 'di phyogs yod zer ba'i gnas der phebs te/ tsi ta 'dra ba'i brag ngos nas/ tshig sgra dang sman dri bzang po yongs su 'thul bar khrom gter du spyan drang zhing (drangs shing) kun gyi ngo mtshar skyes te rten 'brel phun sum 'tshogs par 'gyur (gyur) ro/ slar lo mang song skabs smon sras rin po che mchog nas d+ha ris bkrol te 'gro la spel chog pa'i bka' yi gnang ba spyi bor du (bo ru) thob pa dang / rang dbon rgyal sras mchog gis rten 'brel rdzas kyi sna drangs te yang nan bka' bsdus mdzad 'dug pa dang*/ de mtshungs ye shes tshul khrims dang / g.yung drung 'od zer rgyal bstan bra bo rgya mtsho khro dar sogs nas nye bar bskul ngor/ gshen gyi bla brang du shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
ces pa 'di ni skyang nam gyis bgyis so//
